_doc: Capacity-planning template for Bold Use #2 (direct persona-to-Commander email). NOT the live routing config -- that is config/persona_inboxes.json (read by core/email/persona_email_responder.py), which already has Sterling ACTIVE at sterling-thunderbird@agentmail.to. This file is the activation checklist + cost model for the remaining personas, gated on inbox capacity. When a persona below is activated: (1) create the inbox, (2) add it to persona_inboxes.json with status='active', (3) flip status here to 'deployed', (4) restart persona-email-responder.timer.
